definitions.gloss: to jump down; to jump off
definitions.explanation: To leap from a height to a lower place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{飛|と}び{降|お}りた。
examples.english: The child jumped down from the tree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{降|お}りて⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いけない→いけない：02335_ikenai⟧。
examples.english: You must not jump off before the train stops.

examples.japanese: ⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{飛|と}び{降|お}りる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Jumping off the roof is dangerous.

notes:
FORMATION:
Compound verb: ⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ (to fly, to jump) + ⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧ (to descend, to get off).

USAGE:
・〜⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{飛|と}び{降|お}りる (to jump down from ~)

The starting point takes ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧, not ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧. The verb is intransitive, so it never takes a direct object.

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
・⟦{飛|と}び{乗|の}る→飛び乗る：30324_tobinoru⟧ - to jump onto (the opposite motion)
・⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}む→飛び込む：04614_tobikomu⟧ - to jump/dive in
・⟦{飛|と}び{上|あ}がる→飛び上がる：06345_tobiagaru⟧ - to jump up
・⟦{飛|と}び{出|だ}す→飛び出す：02374_tobidasu⟧ - to jump out
